related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

request.operation: publish a content-integrity-verifiable improvement relation for the bounded activity projection
request.supersession_reason: The earlier relation used a 40-character Git blob ID in the SHA-256 field; this append-only follow-up uses the actual 64-character content digest.

outcome.implementation_change: The ECI projection groups unclassified capability calls with exact binding and source-event references, and relates declared probes to that activity without inferring agent intent or service failure.
outcome.verification_basis: The focused ECI and projection CLI suites passed 164 tests. An authenticated live projection exposed three authentic calls with exact event references and returned a partial, truncated result.
outcome.analysis_limit: The implementation and projection path are verified. Ambient scheduler decisions are already represented separately in the current session snapshot; the historical calls remain unclassified because their event records lack that context. No reduction in agent burden has been measured.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Session evidence records ambient capability calls without the scheduler decisions that explain them
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose bounded scheduled and skipped owner-pass decisions with measured pass duration in the entry response and the existing session activity projection, without adding a write for a quiet run.

improvement_relation.basis: The projection's bounded activity representation is covered by focused regression tests and demonstrated on authentic session events. The new records use actual SHA-256 source digests; the resulting live readback will independently report source integrity and relation status. This documents a verified observability capability, not empirically reduced intervention or service fulfillment.
